title: Closeout summary: S01T04 - Add core AgentDirective types and exports
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Added core AgentDirective types and exports in @boreal/core. Introduced packages/core/src/agent-directives.ts with branded directive, bundle, template, version, and registry version IDs; directive family, severity, audience, kind, lifecycle, source, subject, applies-to, acknowledgement, data, conflict, deprecation, missing-required, template, bundle metadata, and bundle contracts. Exported the module from packages/core/src/index.ts. Validated with pnpm exec tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json --pretty false, git diff --check on the S01T04 files, bwrk docs check --json, bwrk schema validate --json, bwrk sync refresh --json, and bwrk doctor --strict --json.

Close reason: core AgentDirective types and exports added
